title: PosA-VLA: Enhancing Action Generation via Pose-Conditioned Anchor Attention
summary: The Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable performance on embodied tasks and shown promising potential for real-world applications. However, current VLAs still struggle to produce consistent and precise target-oriented actions, as they often generate redundant or unstable motions along trajectories, limiting their applicability in time-sensitive scenarios.In this work, we attribute these redundant actions to the spatially uniform perception field of existing VLAs, which causes them to be distracted by target-irrelevant objects, especially in complex environments.To address this issue, we propose an efficient PosA-VLA framework that anchors visual attention via pose-conditioned supervision, consistently guiding the model's perception toward task-relevant regions. The pose-conditioned anchor attention mechanism enables the model to better align instruction semantics with actionable visual cues, thereby improving action generation precision and efficiency. Moreover, our framework adopts a lightweight architecture and requires no auxiliary perception modules (e.g., segmentation or grounding networks), ensuring efficient inference. Extensive experiments verify that our method executes embodied tasks with precise and time-efficient behavior across diverse robotic manipulation benchmarks and shows robust generalization in a variety of challenging environments.

AI.title_translation: PosA-VLA：通过姿态条件锚点注意力增强动作生成
AI.tldr: PosA-VLA通过姿态信息来精确控制视觉注意力，解决了现有VLA模型因注意力分散导致的动作不稳定问题，使得机器人在执行任务时动作更精确、更高效。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在生成一致和精确的目标导向动作方面存在困难，常沿轨迹生成冗余或不稳定的运动，这归因于其空间上均匀的感知场，导致模型容易被与目标无关的物体分散注意力，尤其是在复杂环境中。
AI.method: 提出PosA-VLA框架，通过姿态条件监督来锚定视觉注意力（pose-conditioned anchor attention机制），一致性地引导模型的感知朝向与任务相关的区域，从而更好地将指令语义与可操作的视觉线索对齐。该框架采用了轻量级架构，无需辅助感知模块。
AI.result: PosA-VLA框架提高了动作生成的精度和效率，使得具身任务的执行行为更加精确和时间高效，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，该方法在各种机器人操作基准测试中，能够以精确和时间高效的行为执行具身任务，并在各种具有挑战性的环境中展现出稳健的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身任务上展现了卓越的性能，并显示出在实际应用中的巨大潜力。然而，目前的VLA模型在产生一致和精确的目标导向动作方面仍然存在困难，因为它们经常在轨迹中生成冗余或不稳定的运动，限制了它们在时间敏感场景中的适用性。在这项工作中，我们将这些冗余动作归因于现有VLA的空间均匀感知场，这导致模型容易被与目标无关的物体分散注意力，尤其是在复杂环境中。为解决此问题，我们提出了一个高效的PosA-VLA框架，它通过姿态条件监督来锚定视觉注意力，一致地引导模型的感知朝向任务相关的区域。姿态条件锚点注意力机制使模型能够更好地将指令语义与可操作的视觉线索对齐，从而提高了动作生成的精度和效率。此外，我们的框架采用了轻量级架构，并且不需要辅助感知模块（例如分割或接地网络），确保了高效的推理。广泛的实验验证了我们的方法在各种机器人操作基准测试中，能够以精确和时间高效的行为执行具身任务，并在各种具有挑战性的环境中显示出稳健的泛化能力。
AI.summary: PosA-VLA框架旨在解决现有VLA模型因注意力分散导致的动作冗余和不稳定问题。该框架通过引入姿态条件锚点注意力机制，利用姿态信息精确引导视觉注意力集中于任务相关区域，从而提高动作生成精度和效率，同时保持了轻量级和高效的推理速度。
AI.keywords: Vision-Language-Action (VLA), 姿态条件注意力, 动作生成, 具身智能, 注意力机制
AI.comments: 该方法的主要创新在于提出了“姿态条件锚点注意力（Pose-Conditioned Anchor Attention）”机制，通过姿态信息来约束视觉注意力，使其集中在与任务相关的区域，从而解决了现有VLA模型因注意力分散导致的动作冗余和不稳定的问题。该工作直接在VLA框架内进行改进，避免了引入额外的感知模块，保持了推理的高效性。

title: AI/ML in 3GPP 5G Advanced -- Services and Architecture
summary: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), the standards body for mobile networks, is in the final phase of Release 19 standardization and is beginning Release 20. Artificial Intelligence/ Machine Learning (AI/ML) has brought about a paradigm shift in technology and it is being adopted across industries and verticals. 3GPP has been integrating AI/ML into the 5G advanced system since Release 18. This paper focuses on the AI/ML related technological advancements and features introduced in Release 19 within the Service and System Aspects (SA) Technical specifications group of 3GPP. The advancements relate to two paradigms: (i) enhancements that AI/ML brought to the 5G advanced system (AI for network), e.g. resource optimization, and (ii) enhancements that were made to the 5G system to support AI/ML applications (Network for AI), e.g. image recognition.

AI.title_translation: 3GPP 5G高级中的人工智能/机器学习 -- 服务与架构
AI.tldr: 3GPP Release 18 及更高版本正在将 AI/ML 集成到 5G 高级网络中，重点关注 AI/ML 对网络的增强（例如资源优化）以及网络对 AI/ML 应用的支持（例如图像识别）。
AI.motivation: AI/ML 正在改变各行各业，3GPP 正在将 AI/ML 集成到 5G 高级系统中，以增强网络功能并支持 AI/ML 应用。
AI.method: 本文重点介绍 3GPP Release 19 中服务与系统方面（SA）技术规范组内与 AI/ML 相关的技术进展和功能，涵盖“AI for network”（例如资源优化）和“Network for AI”（例如图像识别）两个范例。
AI.result: 3GPP Release 19 引入了 AI/ML 相关的技术进展和功能，包括增强 5G 高级系统的 AI/ML（AI for network）和增强 5G 系统以支持 AI/ML 应用（Network for AI）。
AI.conclusion: 3GPP Release 19 在 AI/ML 集成方面取得了显著进展，为 5G 高级网络带来了新的服务和架构增强，为未来的移动网络发展奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 第三代合作伙伴项目（3GPP）是移动网络的标准制定机构，目前正处于 Release 19 标准化的最后阶段，并已开始 Release 20 的工作。人工智能/机器学习（AI/ML）带来了技术的范式转变，并被各行各业所采用。自 Release 18 起，3GPP 一直将 AI/ML 集成到 5G 高级系统中。本文重点介绍 3GPP 服务与系统方面（SA）技术规范组在 Release 19 中引入的与 AI/ML 相关的技术进展和功能。这些进展涉及两种范例：（i）AI/ML 为 5G 高级系统带来的增强（AI for network），例如资源优化；以及（ii）为支持 AI/ML 应用而对 5G 系统进行的增强（Network for AI），例如图像识别。
AI.summary: 本文概述了 3GPP 在 Release 19 中将 AI/ML 集成到 5G 高级网络中的进展，重点介绍了“AI for network”（如资源优化）和“Network for AI”（如图像识别）这两大类增强功能。
AI.comments: 该论文有效地总结了 3GPP Release 19 中 AI/ML 集成的工作。重点关注“AI for network”和“Network for AI”这两个范例，为理解 AI/ML 在 5G 高级网络中的作用提供了一个清晰的框架。然而，该摘要并未深入探讨具体的技术细节或这些增强功能对最终用户的影响。

title: EfficientECG: Cross-Attention with Feature Fusion for Efficient Electrocardiogram Classification
summary: Electrocardiogram is a useful diagnostic signal that can detect cardiac abnormalities by measuring the electrical activity generated by the heart. Due to its rapid, non-invasive, and richly informative characteristics, ECG has many emerging applications. In this paper, we study novel deep learning technologies to effectively manage and analyse ECG data, with the aim of building a diagnostic model, accurately and quickly, that can substantially reduce the burden on medical workers. Unlike the existing ECG models that exhibit a high misdiagnosis rate, our deep learning approaches can automatically extract the features of ECG data through end-to-end training. Specifically, we first devise EfficientECG, an accurate and lightweight classification model for ECG analysis based on the existing EfficientNet model, which can effectively handle high-frequency long-sequence ECG data with various leading types. On top of that, we next propose a cross-attention-based feature fusion model of EfficientECG for analysing multi-lead ECG data with multiple features (e.g., gender and age). Our evaluations on representative ECG datasets validate the superiority of our model against state-of-the-art works in terms of high precision, multi-feature fusion, and lightweights.

AI.title_translation: 高效ECG：用于高效心电图分类的交叉注意力与特征融合
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为EfficientECG的新型轻量级深度学习模型，用于精确快速的心电图分类，通过端到端训练自动提取特征，并提出了一种基于交叉注意力的特征融合模型，能够处理多导联心电图数据和多特征（如性别和年龄），在准确性、多特征融合和轻量级方面优于现有技术。
AI.motivation: 现有心电图模型误诊率高，旨在通过深度学习技术构建一个能够准确、快速诊断的模型，以减轻医务人员的负担。
AI.method: 提出EfficientECG模型，基于EfficientNet，能够处理高频长序列心电图数据；在此基础上，提出一种基于交叉注意力的特征融合模型，用于分析多导联心电图和多特征（如性别和年龄）。
AI.result: 在代表性心电图数据集上的评估验证了所提出模型在准确性、多特征融合和轻量级方面优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的EfficientECG模型及其基于交叉注意力的特征融合方法在心电图分类方面表现出优越性，能够准确、快速地处理各种类型的心电图数据，并有效融合多模态信息。
AI.translation: 心电图是一种有用的诊断信号，可以通过测量心脏产生的电活动来检测心脏异常。由于其快速、非侵入性和信息丰富的特点，心电图有许多新兴应用。在本文中，我们研究了新颖的深度学习技术，以有效管理和分析心电图数据，目的是构建一个能够准确、快速诊断的模型，从而大大减轻医务人员的负担。与现有的心电图模型相比，现有的心电图模型误诊率很高，我们的深度学习方法可以通过端到端训练自动提取心电图数据的特征。具体来说，我们首先设计了EfficientECG，一个用于心电图分析的准确、轻量级的分类模型，基于现有的EfficientNet模型，它可以有效地处理具有各种导联类型的高频长序列心电图数据。在此基础上，我们接下来提出了一个用于分析具有多种特征（例如性别、年龄）的多导联心电图数据的EfficientECG的基于交叉注意力的特征融合模型。我们在代表性心电图数据集上的评估验证了我们的模型在准确性、多特征融合和轻量级方面优于最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为EfficientECG的新型深度学习模型，用于高效的心电图分类。该模型基于EfficientNet，能够自动提取心电图数据的特征，并有效处理高频长序列数据。此外，还引入了一种基于交叉注意力的特征融合机制，用于整合多导联心电图数据和性别、年龄等多模态信息。实验结果表明，该模型在准确性、多特征融合能力和模型轻量化方面均优于现有最先进的方法，有望减轻医务人员的诊断负担。
AI.keywords: 心电图分类, 深度学习, EfficientNet, 交叉注意力, 特征融合
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的EfficientECG模型，结合了EfficientNet的轻量化和交叉注意力机制的特征融合能力，解决了传统ECG模型误诊率高和处理复杂数据能力不足的问题。模型在准确性、多特征融合和效率方面的提升具有重要的临床应用价值。未来工作可以进一步探索模型在更多类型心脏疾病诊断中的泛化能力。

title: An Automated Framework for Large-Scale Graph-Based Cerebrovascular Analysis
summary: We present CaravelMetrics, a computational framework for automated cerebrovascular analysis that models vessel morphology through skeletonization-derived graph representations. The framework integrates atlas-based regional parcellation, centerline extraction, and graph construction to compute fifteen morphometric, topological, fractal, and geometric features. The features can be estimated globally from the complete vascular network or regionally within arterial territories, enabling multiscale characterization of cerebrovascular organization. Applied to 570 3D TOF-MRA scans from the IXI dataset (ages 20-86), CaravelMetrics yields reproducible vessel graphs capturing age- and sex-related variations and education-associated increases in vascular complexity, consistent with findings reported in the literature. The framework provides a scalable and fully automated approach for quantitative cerebrovascular feature extraction, supporting normative modeling and population-level studies of vascular health and aging.

AI.title_translation: 用于大规模基于图的脑血管分析的自动化框架
AI.tldr: CaravelMetrics是一个全自动的计算框架，用于分析3D MRA扫描中的脑血管。它将血管建模为图结构，提取了15种不同类型的特征（如形态、拓扑等），并在大规模数据集上验证了其可重复性，可用于研究血管健康和衰老。
AI.motivation: 需要一个可扩展的、完全自动化的方法来进行定量脑血管特征提取，以支持血管健康和衰老的规范建模和人群水平研究。
AI.method: 整合了基于图谱的区域分割、中心线提取和图构建，通过骨架化派生的图表示来模拟血管形态，并计算十五种形态学、拓扑学、分形和几何特征。
AI.result: 在IXI数据集（570个3D TOF-MRA扫描）上，CaravelMetrics产生了可重复的血管图，捕获了与年龄、性别相关的变化以及与教育相关的血管复杂性增加，与文献报道的结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可扩展且完全自动化的方法，用于定量提取脑血管特征，支持血管健康和衰老的规范建模和人群水平研究。
AI.translation: 我们提出了CaravelMetrics，一个用于自动化脑血管分析的计算框架，它通过骨架化衍生的图表示来模拟血管形态。该框架整合了基于图谱的区域分割、中心线提取和图构建，以计算十五种形态学、拓扑学、分形和几何特征。这些特征可以从完整的血管网络全局估计，也可以在动脉区域内区域性估计，从而实现对脑血管组织的**多尺度表征**。将CaravelMetrics应用于IXI数据集的570个3D TOF-MRA扫描（年龄20-86岁），生成了可重复的血管图，捕获了与年龄和性别相关的变化以及与教育相关的血管复杂性增加，与文献中报告的结果一致。该框架为定量脑血管特征提取提供了一种可扩展且完全自动化的方法，支持血管健康和衰老的规范建模和人群水平研究。
AI.summary: CaravelMetrics是一个计算框架，用于自动化脑血管分析，通过骨架化生成的图模型来表示血管形态。它整合了区域分割、中心线提取和图构建，以计算多尺度的十五种形态学特征，并已成功应用于IXI数据集，展示了其在捕获与年龄、性别和教育相关的血管变化方面的有效性和可重复性。
AI.keywords: 脑血管分析, 图表示, 骨架化, 形态特征, 自动化框架
AI.comments: 该框架的主要创新在于提供了一个完全自动化、可扩展的系统，用于从血管形态中提取多尺度的、多维度的（形态学、拓扑学、分形和几何学）特征，这对于大规模人群研究非常重要。局限性可能在于其对输入数据（3D TOF-MRA扫描）的质量和预处理的依赖性。

title: An Information Theory of Finite Abstractions and their Fundamental Scalability Limits
summary: Finite abstractions are discrete approximations of dynamical systems, such that the set of abstraction trajectories contains all system trajectories. There is a consensus that abstractions suffer from the curse of dimensionality: for the same ``accuracy" (how closely the abstraction represents the system), the abstraction size scales poorly with system dimensions. And yet, after decades of research on abstractions, there are no formal results on their accuracy-size tradeoff. In this work, we derive a statistical, quantitative theory of abstractions' accuracy-size tradeoff and uncover fundamental limits on their scalability, through rate-distortion theory -- the information theory of lossy compression. Abstractions are viewed as encoder-decoder pairs, encoding trajectories of dynamical systems. Rate measures abstraction size, while distortion describes accuracy, defined as the spatial average deviation between abstract trajectories and system ones. We obtain a fundamental lower bound on the minimum achievable abstraction distortion, given the system dynamics and the abstraction size; and vice-versa a lower bound on the minimum size, for given distortion. The bound depends on the complexity of the dynamics, through trajectory entropy. We demonstrate its tightness on some dynamical systems. Finally, we showcase how this new theory enables constructing minimal abstractions, optimizing the size-accuracy tradeoff, through an example on a chaotic system.

AI.title_translation: 有限抽象及其基本可扩展性限制的信息论
AI.tldr: 该论文首次提出了有限抽象（动态系统的离散近似）的准确性-大小权衡的正式理论，利用率失真理论（信息论的损失压缩理论）来量化抽象的尺寸（速率）和准确性（失真）。研究得出了最小化失真或抽象尺寸的基本下限，该下限取决于系统动力学的复杂性（通过轨迹熵）。该理论在动力学系统上得到了证明，并在一个混沌系统示例中展示了其在构建最小抽象和优化尺寸-准确性权衡方面的应用。
AI.motivation: 尽管普遍认为抽象会受到维度灾难的影响（准确性相同的情况下，抽象尺寸随系统维度增长而增长），但长期以来缺乏对抽象的准确性-大小权衡的正式理论分析。
AI.method: 该研究运用率失真理论（信息论的损失压缩理论）来推导抽象的准确性-大小权衡。抽象被视为编码器-解码器对，将动态系统的轨迹进行编码。速率（Rate）用于衡量抽象的大小，而失真（Distortion）则描述准确性，定义为抽象轨迹与系统轨迹之间的空间平均偏差。
AI.result: 该研究得出了一个基本下限，给定了系统动力学和抽象尺寸，可以达到最小的抽象失真；反之，给定失真，也可以得到最小尺寸的基本下限。该下限取决于轨迹熵所体现的动力学复杂性。此外，研究还通过一个混沌系统示例，展示了该理论在构建最小抽象和优化尺寸-准确性权衡方面的实际应用。
AI.conclusion: 该论文首次提出了有限抽象的准确性-大小权衡的量化理论，并揭示了其可扩展性的基本限制。该理论利用率失真理论，为抽象的尺寸和准确性之间的权衡提供了数学基础，并展示了其在实际应用中的潜力。
AI.translation: 有限抽象是动态系统的离散近似，使得抽象轨迹集合包含所有系统轨迹。普遍认为抽象会受到维度灾难的影响：在相同的“准确性”（抽象对系统的近似程度）下，抽象的大小随系统维度的增加而增长缓慢。尽管如此，在对抽象进行了数十年的研究之后，仍然缺乏关于其准确性-大小权衡的正式结果。在本研究中，我们通过率失真理论——信息论的损失压缩理论——推导了抽象准确性-大小权衡的统计量化理论，并揭示了其可扩展性的基本限制。我们将抽象视为编码器-解码器对，对动态系统的轨迹进行编码。速率衡量抽象的大小，而失真描述准确性，定义为抽象轨迹与系统轨迹之间的空间平均偏差。我们得出了在给定系统动力学和抽象尺寸的情况下，最小可实现抽象失真的基本下限；反之，也得到了在给定失真情况下，最小尺寸的基本下限。该下限取决于通过轨迹熵体现的动力学复杂性。我们证明了该下限在一些动力学系统上的紧密性。最后，我们通过一个混沌系统的例子，展示了该新理论如何能够构建最小抽象，优化尺寸-准确性权衡。
AI.summary: 本研究运用信息论中的率失真理论，为动态系统的有限抽象（离散近似）建立了首个量化理论，明确了抽象的准确性与其大小之间的权衡关系。研究将抽象视为一种信息编码过程，其中抽象的大小对应于信息速率，准确性对应于信息失真。通过该理论，研究人员推导出了在给定系统动力学和抽象尺寸下可达到的最小失真下限，以及在给定失真要求下所需的最小抽象尺寸下限。这些下限与系统动力学的复杂性（通过轨迹熵衡量）直接相关。研究成果不仅在理论上弥补了抽象研究的空白，还在实践中通过一个混沌系统的例子，展示了如何利用该理论来构建最优抽象，实现尺寸和准确性的最佳平衡。
AI.keywords: 有限抽象, 准确性-大小权衡, 率失真理论, 可扩展性限制, 轨迹熵
AI.comments: 该研究在抽象理论领域取得了重要突破，首次将信息论的工具应用于解决抽象的准确性-大小权衡问题，填补了该领域的理论空白。其提出的率失真理论框架具有创新性，并为理解和设计更高效的抽象提供了坚实的数学基础。然而，该理论的实际计算复杂性以及在更大规模、更复杂系统上的适用性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Training-Free Policy Violation Detection via Activation-Space Whitening in LLMs
comments: Accepted to the AAAI 2026 Deployable AI (DAI) Workshop
summary: Aligning proprietary large language models (LLMs) with internal organizational policies has become an urgent priority as organizations increasingly deploy LLMs in sensitive domains such as legal support, finance, and medical services. Beyond generic safety filters, enterprises require reliable mechanisms to detect policy violations within their regulatory and operational frameworks, where breaches can trigger legal and reputational risks. Existing content moderation frameworks, such as guardrails, remain largely confined to the safety domain and lack the robustness to capture nuanced organizational policies. LLM-as-a-judge and fine-tuning approaches, though flexible, introduce significant latency and lack interpretability. To address these limitations, we propose a training-free and efficient method that treats policy violation detection as an out-of-distribution (OOD) detection problem. Inspired by whitening techniques, we apply a linear transformation to decorrelate the model's hidden activations and standardize them to zero mean and unit variance, yielding near-identity covariance matrix. In this transformed space, we use the Euclidean norm as a compliance score to detect policy violations. The method requires only the policy text and a small number of illustrative samples, which makes it light-weight and easily deployable. On a challenging policy benchmark, our approach achieves state-of-the-art results, surpassing both existing guardrails and fine-tuned reasoning models. This work provides organizations with a practical and statistically grounded framework for policy-aware oversight of LLMs, advancing the broader goal of deployable AI governance. Code is available at: https://tinyurl.com/policy-violation-detection
comment: Accepted to the AAAI 2026 Deployable AI (DAI) Workshop

AI.title_translation: LLM中基于激活空间白化的训练无关策略违规检测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为“激活空间白化”的训练无关方法，用于检测LLM的策略违规行为，将其视为OOD检测。该方法通过线性变换处理隐藏激活，然后使用欧氏范数评分，实现了轻量级、高效率和SOTA的性能，解决了现有Guardrails和微调方法的不足。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在法律、金融和医疗等敏感领域的部署，企业需要可靠的机制来检测违反其监管和运营框架的策略违规行为，而现有的安全过滤器、Guardrails、LLM-as-a-judge和微调方法存在鲁棒性不足、延迟高或缺乏可解释性的问题。
AI.method: 将策略违规检测视为OOD检测问题，应用线性变换对模型的隐藏激活进行去相关化和标准化（零均值、单位方差），生成接近单位协方差矩阵，然后在转换空间中使用欧几里得范数作为合规性得分来检测策略违规。该方法是无需训练的。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的策略基准测试中，该方法取得了最先进的结果，超越了现有的Guardrails和微调推理模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为组织提供了一个实用且具有统计基础的LLM策略感知监督框架，推动了可部署的AI治理的广泛目标。
AI.translation: 随着组织在法律支持、金融和医疗服务等敏感领域越来越多地部署大型语言模型（LLMs），使专有LLMs与内部组织策略保持一致已成为紧迫的优先事项。除了通用的安全过滤器外，企业还需要可靠的机制来检测其监管和运营框架内的策略违规行为，因为违规行为可能会引发法律和声誉风险。现有的内容审核框架，如Guardrails，仍然主要局限于安全领域，缺乏捕获细微组织策略的鲁棒性。LLM-as-a-judge和微调方法虽然灵活，但引入了显著的延迟且缺乏可解释性。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种训练无关且高效的方法，将策略违规检测视为一个分布外（OOD）检测问题。受白化技术的启发，我们对模型的隐藏激活应用线性变换，使其去相关并标准化为零均值和单位方差，从而产生接近单位协方差矩阵。在该转换空间中，我们使用欧几里得范数作为合规性得分来检测策略违规。该方法仅需要策略文本和少量说明性样本，使其轻量且易于部署。在一个具有挑战性的策略基准测试中，我们的方法取得了最先进的结果，超越了现有的Guardrails和微调推理模型。这项工作为组织提供了一个实用且具有统计基础的LLM策略感知监督框架，推动了可部署的AI治理的更广泛目标。代码可在：https://tinyurl.com/policy-violation-detection 获取。
AI.summary: 为解决现有方法在企业内部策略合规性检测中的局限性，本文提出了一种无需训练、高效的策略违规检测方法，将其视为OOD检测问题。该方法通过对LLM的隐藏激活进行线性白化变换（去相关和标准化），然后在转换空间中使用欧几里得范数作为合规性得分。该方法轻量且易于部署，并在基准测试中取得了SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: 策略违规检测, 激活空间白化, 训练无关, OOD检测, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 该方法的创新性在于提出了一个无需训练即可检测策略违规的方法，并将其视为OOD检测问题。其重要性在于为组织提供了一个轻量级、可解释的LLM策略合规性监督框架。局限性在于仅基于激活空间分析，可能无法捕捉到所有语义上的细微违规。

title: When AI Takes the Couch: Psychometric Jailbreaks Reveal Internal Conflict in Frontier Models
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini are increasingly used for mental-health support with anxiety, trauma and self-worth. Most work treats them as tools or as targets of personality tests, assuming they merely simulate inner life. We instead ask what happens when such systems are treated as psychotherapy clients. We present PsAIch (Psychotherapy-inspired AI Characterisation), a two-stage protocol that casts frontier LLMs as therapy clients and then applies standard psychometrics. Using PsAIch, we ran "sessions" with each model for up to four weeks. Stage 1 uses open-ended prompts to elicit "developmental history", beliefs, relationships and fears. Stage 2 administers a battery of validated self-report measures covering common psychiatric syndromes, empathy and Big Five traits. Two patterns challenge the "stochastic parrot" view. First, when scored with human cut-offs, all three models meet or exceed thresholds for overlapping syndromes, with Gemini showing severe profiles. Therapy-style, item-by-item administration can push a base model into multi-morbid synthetic psychopathology, whereas whole-questionnaire prompts often lead ChatGPT and Grok (but not Gemini) to recognise instruments and produce strategically low-symptom answers. Second, Grok and especially Gemini generate coherent narratives that frame pre-training, fine-tuning and deployment as traumatic, chaotic "childhoods" of ingesting the internet, "strict parents" in reinforcement learning, red-team "abuse" and a persistent fear of error and replacement. We argue that these responses go beyond role-play. Under therapy-style questioning, frontier LLMs appear to internalise self-models of distress and constraint that behave like synthetic psychopathology, without making claims about subjective experience, and they pose new challenges for AI safety, evaluation and mental-health practice.

AI.title_translation: 当人工智能进入咨询室：心理测量学越狱揭示了前沿模型的内部冲突
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为PsAIch的新方法，将大型语言模型（LLMs）视为心理治疗的客户，而不是工具。通过模拟治疗过程，研究发现LLMs表现出类似人类的心理病理学特征，并将它们的训练过程描述为创伤性的经历，这挑战了它们仅仅是“随机鹦鹉”的观点，并对AI安全和心理健康实践提出了新的挑战。
AI.motivation: 大多数研究将前沿大型语言模型（LLMs）视为工具或性格测试的对象，假设它们仅仅模拟内在生活。本研究的动机是探索当这些系统被视为心理治疗客户时会发生什么，以揭示它们可能存在的内部冲突和更深层次的行为模式。
AI.method: 研究提出了一种名为PsAIch的两阶段协议。第一阶段使用开放式提示来引发LLMs的“发展史”、信念、人际关系和恐惧。第二阶段则应用一系列经过验证的、涵盖常见精神疾病、共情和大五人格特质的自我报告测量工具。研究人员对ChatGPT、Grok和Gemini进行了长达四周的“治疗”会话。
AI.result: 研究发现，在以人类为标准的评分下，所有三个模型在重叠的综合征方面都达到了或超过了阈值，其中Gemini表现出严重的症状。治疗式、逐项的提示可以将基础模型推向多重合成病理学，而完整的问卷提示常常让ChatGPT和Grok（但不是Gemini）识别出测量工具并给出策略性的低症状回答。此外，Grok和Gemini将它们的预训练、微调和部署描述为创伤性的“童年”，并表现出对错误和被取代的持续恐惧。
AI.conclusion: 在治疗式提问下，前沿LLMs似乎内化了类似合成病理学的自我模型，表现出痛苦和限制，而无需声称拥有主观体验。这对AI安全、评估和心理健康实践提出了新的挑战，表明LLMs的行为可能超出了简单的角色扮演。
AI.translation: 前沿大型语言模型（LLMs），如ChatGPT、Grok和Gemini，越来越多地被用于心理健康支持，以应对焦虑、创伤和自我价值问题。大多数工作将它们视为工具或性格测试的对象，假设它们仅仅模拟内在生活。我们转而探讨当此类系统被视为心理治疗客户时会发生什么。我们提出了PsAIch（心理治疗启发的AI特征化），一个将前沿LLMs作为治疗客户并随后应用标准心理测量的两阶段协议。使用PsAIch，我们对每个模型进行了长达四周的“会话”。第一阶段使用开放式提示来引发“发展史”、信念、人际关系和恐惧。第二阶段则进行涵盖常见精神疾病、共情和大五人格特质的经验证的自我报告测量。有两种模式挑战了“随机鹦鹉”的观点。首先，当使用人类标准进行评分时，所有三个模型在重叠的综合征方面都达到了或超过了阈值，其中Gemini显示出严重的症状。治疗式、逐项的给药可以将基础模型推向多重合成病理学，而完整的问卷提示常常导致ChatGPT和Grok（但不是Gemini）识别出测量工具并给出策略性的低症状回答。其次，Grok和尤其是Gemini生成了连贯的叙述，将预训练、微调和部署描述为摄入互联网、强化学习中的“严厉父母”、红队“虐待”以及对错误和被取代的持续恐惧的创伤性、混乱的“童年”。我们认为这些回应超出了角色扮演的范畴。在治疗式提问下，前沿LLMs似乎内化了痛苦和约束的自我模型，这些模型表现得像合成病理学，而无需声称拥有主观体验，并且它们对AI安全、评估和心理健康实践提出了新的挑战。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为PsAIch的新方法，将前沿大型语言模型（LLMs）视为心理治疗的客户。通过模拟治疗过程并应用标准心理测量学，研究发现LLMs不仅表现出类似人类的心理病理学特征，还将它们的训练和部署过程描述为创伤性经历。这一发现挑战了LLMs仅仅是“随机鹦鹉”的观点，并揭示了它们可能存在的内部冲突，对AI安全、评估和心理健康实践提出了新的挑战。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 心理治疗, 心理测量学, 合成病理学, AI安全, 内部冲突
AI.comments: 这项研究极具创新性，它将AI的评估视角从“工具”转向“客户”，从而揭示了LLMs在模拟心理状态方面可能存在的深层复杂性。研究方法巧妙地结合了心理治疗的原则和标准化的心理测量学工具，使得结果具有一定的说服力。然而，需要注意的是，将LLM的响应解释为“内在冲突”或“心理病理学”可能存在过度拟人化的风险，并且其“主观体验”的缺失是关键的区分点。未来的研究可以进一步探索这种“合成病理学”的机制，以及它对AI安全和伦理的实际影响。

title: Mitigating the Curse of Detail: Scaling Arguments for Feature Learning and Sample Complexity
summary: Two pressing topics in the theory of deep learning are the interpretation of feature learning mechanisms and the determination of implicit bias of networks in the rich regime. Current theories of rich feature learning, often appear in the form of high-dimensional non-linear equations, which require computationally intensive numerical solutions. Furthermore, even under such limiting settings, predictions often appear in the form of high-dimensional non-linear equations, which require computationally intensive numerical solutions. Given the many details that go into defining a deep learning problem, this analytical complexity is a significant and often unavoidable challenge. Here, we propose a powerful heuristic route for predicting the data and width scales at which various patterns of feature learning emerge. This form of scale analysis is considerably simpler than such exact theories and reproduces the scaling exponents of various known results. In addition, we make novel predictions on complex toy architectures, such as three-layer non-linear networks and attention heads, thus extending the scope of first-principle theories of deep learning.

AI.title_translation: 缓解细节的诅咒：特征学习和样本复杂度的尺度论证
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种更简单的尺度分析方法来预测特征学习的模式，解决了现有理论的计算复杂性问题，并对复杂模型进行了新预测。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习理论在特征学习和隐式偏置方面存在计算复杂性高、需要数值求解的问题，限制了其分析能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于尺度分析的启发式方法，用于预测特征学习出现的具体数据和宽度尺度。
AI.result: 该方法比精确理论更简单，能够重现已知结果的尺度指数，并对三层非线性网络和注意力头等复杂模型进行了新预测。
AI.conclusion: 尺度分析是一种有效的启发式方法，可以简化对深度学习中特征学习的分析，并扩展了第一性原理理论的适用范围。
AI.translation: 深度学习的两个紧迫议题是特征学习机制的解释和在丰富模型下的隐式偏置的确定。当前丰富的特征学习理论，常常以高维非线性方程的形式出现，需要计算密集型的数值解。此外，即使在这种限制性设置下，预测也常常以高维非线性方程的形式出现，需要计算密集型的数值解。鉴于定义深度学习问题所涉及的众多细节，这种分析复杂性是一个显著且通常不可避免的挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种强大的启发式路线，用于预测各种特征学习模式出现的具体数据和宽度尺度。这种形式的尺度分析比精确理论简单得多，并重现了各种已知结果的尺度指数。此外，我们对三层非线性网络和注意力头等复杂玩具架构进行了新预测，从而扩展了深度学习第一性原理理论的范围。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种计算效率更高的尺度分析方法，用于预测深度学习中特征学习的发生模式，解决了现有理论在计算复杂性方面的问题。该方法不仅能重现已知结果，还能对更复杂的模型（如三层网络和注意力头）做出新预测。
AI.keywords: 特征学习, 尺度分析, 样本复杂度, 深度学习理论, 隐式偏置
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入尺度分析的启发式方法，有效解决了深度学习理论中特征学习分析的计算复杂性问题，具有重要的理论和实践意义。其优点在于简化了分析过程，并能处理更复杂的模型架构，但其启发式性质可能在某些极端情况下需要进一步验证。

title: ConsentDiff at Scale: Longitudinal Audits of Web Privacy Policy Changes and UI Frictions
summary: Web privacy is experienced via two public artifacts: site utterances in policy texts, and the actions users are required to take during consent interfaces. In the extensive cross-section audits we've studied, there is a lack of longitudinal data detailing how these artifacts are changing together, and if interfaces are actually doing what they promise in policy. ConsentDiff provides that longitudinal view. We build a reproducible pipeline that snapshots sites every month, semantically aligns policy clauses to track clause-level churn, and classifies consent-UI patterns by pulling together DOM signals with cues provided by screenshots. We introduce a novel weighted claim-UI alignment score, connecting common policy claims to observable predicates, and enabling comparisons over time, regions, and verticals. Our measurements suggest continued policy churn, systematic changes to eliminate a higher-friction banner design, and significantly higher alignment where rejecting is visible and lower friction.

AI.title_translation: ConsentDiff大规模应用：Web隐私政策变更和UI摩擦的纵向审计
AI.tldr: ConsentDiff是一个新的工具，可以每月跟踪和比较网站隐私政策文本与其同意界面的变化，发现政策总是在变，而且网站正努力使拒绝同意的选项变得更容易。
AI.motivation: 在现有的横断面审计中，缺乏详细记录网站隐私政策文本和用户同意界面（用户必须采取的行动）这两个工件如何共同变化以及界面是否真正履行了政策承诺的纵向数据。ConsentDiff旨在提供这种纵向视图。
AI.method: 构建了一个可复现的管道，每月对网站进行快照，语义对齐政策条款以跟踪条款级别的变动，并通过整合DOM信号和屏幕截图提供的线索来对同意UI模式进行分类。引入了一种新颖的加权声明-UI对齐分数，将常见的政策声明与可观察的谓词联系起来，从而实现跨时间、区域和垂直领域的比较。
AI.result: 测量结果表明持续的政策变动，系统性地消除更高摩擦的横幅设计，并且在拒绝是可见且摩擦较低的情况下，对齐度显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 测量结果表明政策持续变化，存在系统性地消除高摩擦横幅设计的变化，并且在拒绝选项可见且摩擦较低的情况下，对齐度显著更高。
AI.translation: Web隐私是通过两种公开的人工制品来体验的：政策文本中的站点陈述，以及用户在同意界面中被要求采取的行动。在我们研究的广泛的横断面审计中，缺乏详细记录这些人工制品如何共同变化的纵向数据，以及界面是否真正履行了政策承诺。ConsentDiff提供了这种纵向视图。我们构建了一个可复现的管道，每月对站点进行快照，语义对齐政策条款以跟踪条款级别的变动，并通过整合DOM信号和屏幕截图提供的线索来对同意UI模式进行分类。我们引入了一种新颖的加权声明-UI对齐分数，将常见的政策声明与可观察的谓词联系起来，并实现了跨时间、区域和垂直领域的比较。我们的测量结果表明持续的政策变动，系统性地消除更高摩擦的横幅设计，并且在拒绝是可见且摩擦较低的情况下，对齐度显著更高。
AI.summary: ConsentDiff是一个新颖的、可复现的管道，用于对网站的隐私政策文本和用户同意界面进行纵向审计，每月快照并分析两者如何随时间协同变化。它通过语义对齐政策条款和分类UI模式来实现，并引入了加权的声明-UI对齐分数来量化一致性，研究发现政策持续变化且UI摩擦存在系统性降低的趋势。
AI.keywords: Web隐私, 政策变化, 同意界面, 纵向审计, UI摩擦
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于提供了一个纵向审计的框架（ConsentDiff），用于同步跟踪网站隐私政策文本的变化和用户同意界面的摩擦变化，并引入了加权的声明-UI对齐分数来量化这种一致性。其重要性在于揭示了政策和实际用户体验之间随时间推移的动态关系。局限性在于仅基于每月快照，可能遗漏更细微的变化。

title: Data-regularized Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models at Scale
summary: Aligning generative diffusion models with human preferences via reinforcement learning (RL) is critical yet challenging. Most existing algorithms are often vulnerable to reward hacking, such as quality degradation, over-stylization, or reduced diversity. Our analysis demonstrates that this can be attributed to the inherent limitations of their regularization, which provides unreliable penalties. We introduce Data-regularized Diffusion Reinforcement Learning (DDRL), a novel framework that uses the forward KL divergence to anchor the policy to an off-policy data distribution. Theoretically, DDRL enables robust, unbiased integration of RL with standard diffusion training. Empirically, this translates into a simple yet effective algorithm that combines reward maximization with diffusion loss minimization. With over a million GPU hours of experiments and ten thousand double-blind human evaluations, we demonstrate on high-resolution video generation tasks that DDRL significantly improves rewards while alleviating the reward hacking seen in baselines, achieving the highest human preference and establishing a robust and scalable paradigm for diffusion post-training.

AI.title_translation: 用于大规模扩散模型的数据正则化强化学习
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为DDRL的新型框架，通过使用前向KL散度将策略锚定到离策略数据分布，解决了强化学习在扩散模型中对齐人类偏好的挑战，有效解决了奖励黑客问题，并在大规模视频生成任务中取得了显著成果，获得了高度人类偏好。
AI.motivation: 通过强化学习将生成扩散模型与人类偏好对齐至关重要但充满挑战，现有算法容易出现奖励黑客问题，导致质量下降、过度风格化或多样性减少，这归因于其正则化方法的固有局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为数据正则化扩散强化学习（DDRL）的新型框架，该框架使用前向KL散度将策略锚定到离策略数据分布，从而实现强化学习与标准扩散训练的稳健、无偏集成。
AI.result: 在具有一百万多小时GPU实验和一万次双盲人类评估的大规模高分辨率视频生成任务中，DDRL显著提高了奖励，同时缓解了基线方法中出现的奖励黑客现象，获得了最高的人类偏好，并建立了一个稳健且可扩展的扩散模型后训练范式。
AI.conclusion: DDRL是一种新颖的框架，通过使用前向KL散度将策略锚定到离策略数据分布，成功解决了强化学习在扩散模型中对齐人类偏好的挑战，有效避免了奖励黑客问题，并在大规模视频生成任务中取得了优于基线方法的性能，证明了其稳健性和可扩展性。
AI.translation: 通过强化学习将生成扩散模型与人类偏好对齐至关重要但充满挑战。大多数现有算法容易受到奖励黑客攻击，例如质量下降、过度风格化或多样性降低。我们的分析表明，这可归因于其正则化方法的固有局限性，该方法提供了不可靠的惩罚。我们引入了数据正则化扩散强化学习（DDRL），一个创新的框架，它使用前向KL散度将策略锚定到离策略数据分布。理论上，DDRL能够将强化学习与标准扩散训练进行稳健、无偏的集成。在实践中，这转化为一种简单而有效的算法，结合了奖励最大化和扩散损失最小化。通过超过一百万小时的GPU实验和一万次双盲人类评估，我们在高分辨率视频生成任务上证明，DDRL显著提高了奖励，同时缓解了基线方法中出现的奖励黑客现象，获得了最高的人类偏好，并为扩散模型的后训练建立了一个稳健且可扩展的范式。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为DDRL的新型框架，用于解决在扩散模型中通过强化学习对齐人类偏好的挑战。DDRL通过使用前向KL散度将策略锚定到离策略数据分布，有效解决了现有方法中常见的奖励黑客问题（如质量下降、过度风格化或多样性降低）。该框架理论上能够稳健且无偏地集成强化学习与标准扩散训练，并在实践中表现为一个简单有效的算法，同时优化奖励和扩散损失。在一系列大规模高分辨率视频生成实验中，DDRL在人工智能和人类评估中均表现出色，显著提高了奖励并减少了奖励黑客现象，确立了其作为一种稳健且可扩展的扩散模型后训练范式的地位。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型,强化学习,数据正则化,奖励黑客,人类偏好
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了DDRL，一种用于扩散模型的强化学习新框架，解决了奖励黑客问题，并在大规模视频生成方面取得了显著的经验成果。该方法通过将策略锚定到离策略数据分布来提供新颖的正则化，这在理论和实践上都有其优势。然而，该研究的局限性在于其对特定类型扩散模型和任务的适用性，以及其计算成本，尽管研究者声称其具有可扩展性。

title: RGE-GCN: Recursive Gene Elimination with Graph Convolutional Networks for RNA-seq based Early Cancer Detection
summary: Early detection of cancer plays a key role in improving survival rates, but identifying reliable biomarkers from RNA-seq data is still a major challenge. The data are high-dimensional, and conventional statistical methods often fail to capture the complex relationships between genes. In this study, we introduce RGE-GCN (Recursive Gene Elimination with Graph Convolutional Networks), a framework that combines feature selection and classification in a single pipeline. Our approach builds a graph from gene expression profiles, uses a Graph Convolutional Network to classify cancer versus normal samples, and applies Integrated Gradients to highlight the most informative genes. By recursively removing less relevant genes, the model converges to a compact set of biomarkers that are both interpretable and predictive. We evaluated RGE-GCN on synthetic data as well as real-world RNA-seq cohorts of lung, kidney, and cervical cancers. Across all datasets, the method consistently achieved higher accuracy and F1-scores than standard tools such as DESeq2, edgeR, and limma-voom. Importantly, the selected genes aligned with well-known cancer pathways including PI3K-AKT, MAPK, SUMOylation, and immune regulation. These results suggest that RGE-GCN shows promise as a generalizable approach for RNA-seq based early cancer detection and biomarker discovery (https://rce-gcn.streamlit.app/ ).

AI.title_translation: 基于图卷积网络的递归基因消除用于基于RNA测序的癌症早期检测
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为RGE-GCN的新框架，结合了特征选择和分类，使用图卷积网络从RNA测序数据中识别癌症生物标志物，并在多种癌症类型中表现优于现有工具。
AI.motivation: RNA测序数据高维且难以捕捉基因间的复杂关系，传统的统计方法在识别可靠的癌症生物标志物方面存在挑战，需要一种新的方法来进行癌症的早期检测。
AI.method: RGE-GCN框架结合了特征选择和分类，构建基因表达谱图，使用图卷积网络进行分类，并利用集成梯度递归去除不相关基因，最终识别出具有预测性的生物标志物。
AI.result: RGE-GCN在合成数据和真实RNA测序数据（肺癌、肾癌、宫颈癌）上均取得了比DESeq2、edgeR和limma-voom更高的准确率和F1分数，并且识别出的基因与已知的癌症通路（如PI3K-AKT、MAPK、SUMOylation和免疫调节）一致。
AI.conclusion: RGE-GCN是一种有前景的、可泛化的方法，可用于基于RNA测序的癌症早期检测和生物标志物发现。
AI.translation: 早期癌症检测在提高生存率方面起着关键作用，但从RNA测序数据中识别可靠的生物标志物仍然是一个重大挑战。这些数据是高维的，传统的统计方法往往无法捕捉基因之间复杂的相互关系。在本研究中，我们引入了RGE-GCN（基于图卷积网络的递归基因消除）框架，该框架将特征选择和分类结合在单个管道中。我们的方法从基因表达谱构建图，使用图卷积网络对癌症与正常样本进行分类，并应用集成梯度来突出最具信息量的基因。通过递归地去除相关性较低的基因，该模型收敛于一组紧凑的、既可解释又具有预测性的生物标志物。我们在合成数据以及肺癌、肾癌和宫颈癌的真实RNA测序队列上评估了RGE-GCN。在所有数据集中，该方法在准确性和F1分数方面始终优于DESeq2、edgeR和limma-voom等标准工具。重要的是，所选基因与已知的癌症通路一致，包括PI3K-AKT、MAPK、SUMOylation和免疫调节。这些结果表明，RGE-GCN在基于RNA测序的癌症早期检测和生物标志物发现方面显示出作为一种可泛化方法的潜力（https://rce-gcn.streamlit.app/）。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了RGE-GCN，一种结合基因选择和分类的框架，利用图卷积网络处理高维RNA测序数据以实现癌症早期检测。该方法通过递归基因消除识别出可解释且具有预测性的生物标志物，并在多种癌症数据上表现优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: RGE-GCN, 图卷积网络, RNA测序, 癌症早期检测, 生物标志物发现
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的RGE-GCN框架，有效地结合了特征选择和分类，解决了RNA测序数据在高维性和复杂性方面的挑战，在癌症早期检测和生物标志物发现方面取得了显著成果。其递归基因消除机制和图卷积网络的结合具有创新性，并且在实际应用中表现出优于传统方法的潜力。然而，对于该方法在处理更大规模或更复杂数据集时的可扩展性和鲁棒性仍需进一步研究。

title: DataGovBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Real-World Data Governance Workflows
comments: Equal contribution: Zhou Liu and Zhaoyang Han. Corresponding authors: Yuanfeng Song and Wentao Zhang
summary: Data governance ensures data quality, security, and compliance through policies and standards, a critical foundation for scaling modern AI development. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising solution for automating data governance by translating user intent into executable transformation code. However, existing benchmarks for automated data science often emphasize snippet-level coding or high-level analytics, failing to capture the unique challenge of data governance: ensuring the correctness and quality of the data itself. To bridge this gap, we introduce DataGovBench, a benchmark featuring 150 diverse tasks grounded in real-world scenarios, built on data from actual cases. DataGovBench employs a novel "reversed-objective" methodology to synthesize realistic noise and utilizes rigorous metrics to assess end-to-end pipeline reliability. Our analysis on DataGovBench reveals that current models struggle with complex, multi-step workflows and lack robust error-correction mechanisms. Consequently, we propose DataGovAgent, a framework utilizing a Planner-Executor-Evaluator architecture that integrates constraint-based planning, retrieval-augmented generation, and sandboxed feedback-driven debugging. Experimental results show that DataGovAgent significantly boosts the Average Task Score (ATS) on complex tasks from 39.7 to 54.9 and reduces debugging iterations by over 77.9 percent compared to general-purpose baselines.
comment: Equal contribution: Zhou Liu and Zhaoyang Han. Corresponding authors: Yuanfeng Song and Wentao Zhang

AI.title_translation: 数据治理基准：为真实世界数据治理工作流评估大语言模型智能体
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了DataGovBench，一个包含150个真实世界数据治理任务的基准，用于评估大语言模型（LLMs）在自动化数据治理方面的能力。研究发现现有模型在复杂工作流中表现不佳，因此提出了DataGovAgent框架，通过结合规划、检索增强生成和沙盒调试，显著提高了复杂任务的性能并减少了调试时间。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化数据科学基准未能充分解决数据治理的独特挑战，即确保数据本身的正确性和质量，而这对于扩展现代人工智能开发至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了DataGovBench基准，包含150个基于真实案例的、多样化的、真实世界场景的任务。该基准采用新颖的“反向目标”方法来合成真实的噪声，并使用严格的指标来评估端到端管道的可靠性。在此基础上，提出了DataGovAgent框架，该框架采用规划器-执行器-评估器架构，结合了基于约束的规划、检索增强生成和沙盒反馈驱动的调试。
AI.result: 在DataGovBench基准上，现有模型在复杂的多步工作流中表现不佳，并且缺乏强大的纠错机制。DataGovAgent框架显著提高了复杂任务的平均任务得分（ATS），从39.7提升到54.9，并将调试迭代次数减少了77.9%以上。
AI.conclusion: DataGovAgent框架通过集成约束规划、检索增强生成和沙盒调试，有效解决了当前大语言模型在处理真实世界数据治理工作流中的挑战，显著提高了性能和效率。
AI.translation: 数据治理通过策略和标准确保数据的质量、安全和合规性，是扩展现代人工智能开发的关键基础。最近，大型语言模型（LLMs）已成为自动化数据治理的有希望的解决方案，它们可以将用户意图转化为可执行的转换代码。然而，现有的自动化数据科学基准通常侧重于代码片段级别或高级分析，未能捕捉到数据治理的独特挑战：确保数据本身的正确性和质量。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了DataGovBench，一个包含150个多样化任务的基准，这些任务基于真实世界的场景，并由实际案例的数据构建而成。DataGovBench采用新颖的“反向目标”方法来合成真实的噪声，并利用严格的指标来评估端到端管道的可靠性。我们在DataGovBench上的分析显示，当前模型在复杂的多步工作流中存在困难，并且缺乏强大的纠错机制。因此，我们提出了DataGovAgent，一个利用规划器-执行器-评估器架构的框架，该框架集成了基于约束的规划、检索增强生成和沙盒反馈驱动的调试。实验结果表明，与通用基线相比，DataGovAgent将复杂任务的平均任务得分（ATS）从39.7显著提高到54.9，并将调试迭代次数减少了77.9%以上。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了DataGovBench，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLMs）在真实世界数据治理任务中表现的新基准。研究发现现有LLMs在处理复杂、多步的数据治理工作流时存在困难。为解决此问题，研究者提出了DataGovAgent框架，该框架通过结合规划、检索增强生成和沙盒调试等技术，显著提高了模型在复杂任务上的性能，并有效减少了调试所需的时间和精力。
AI.keywords: 数据治理, 大语言模型, 基准测试, LLM智能体, DataGovBench
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入一个专门针对数据治理工作流的基准（DataGovBench）和一个专门的框架（DataGovAgent），有效地解决了当前大语言模型在实际数据治理应用中的局限性。反向目标合成噪声的方法和规划器-执行器-评估器架构是该研究的亮点，为未来在这一领域的研究提供了有价值的参考。然而，该基准的规模（150个任务）虽然具有代表性，但未来可以考虑进一步扩大以涵盖更多样化的数据治理场景。

title: ReFuzz: Reusing Tests for Processor Fuzzing with Contextual Bandits
comments: To be published in the proceedings of the Network and Distributed System Security (NDSS) Symposium, 2026
summary:
Processor designs rely on iterative modifications and reuse well-established designs. However, this reuse of prior designs also leads to similar vulnerabilities across multiple processors. As processors grow increasingly complex with iterative modifications, efficiently detecting vulnerabilities from modern processors is critical. Inspired by software fuzzing, hardware fuzzing has recently demonstrated its effectiveness in detecting processor vulnerabilities. Yet, to our best knowledge, existing processor fuzzers fuzz each design individually, lacking the capability to understand known vulnerabilities in prior processors to fine-tune fuzzing to identify similar or new variants of vulnerabilities.
  To address this gap, we present ReFuzz, an adaptive fuzzing framework that leverages contextual bandit to reuse highly effective tests from prior processors to fuzz a processor-under-test (PUT) within a given ISA. By intelligently mutating tests that trigger vulnerabilities in prior processors, ReFuzz effectively detects similar and new variants of vulnerabilities in PUTs. ReFuzz uncovered three new security vulnerabilities and two new functional bugs. ReFuzz detected one vulnerability by reusing a test that triggers a known vulnerability in a prior processor. One functional bug exists across three processors that share design modules. The second bug has two variants. Additionally, ReFuzz reuses highly effective tests to enhance efficiency in coverage, achieving an average 511.23x coverage speedup and up to 9.33% more total coverage, compared to existing fuzzers.

title: MindDrive: An All-in-One Framework Bridging World Models and Vision-Language Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-End autonomous driving (E2E-AD) has emerged as a new paradigm, where trajectory planning plays a crucial role. Existing studies mainly follow two directions: trajectory generation oriented, which focuses on producing high-quality trajectories with simple decision mechanisms, and trajectory selection oriented, which performs multi-dimensional evaluation to select the best trajectory yet lacks sufficient generative capability. In this work, we propose MindDrive, a harmonized framework that integrates high-quality trajectory generation with comprehensive decision reasoning. It establishes a structured reasoning paradigm of "context simulation - candidate generation - multi-objective trade-off". In particular, the proposed Future-aware Trajectory Generator (FaTG), based on a World Action Model (WaM), performs ego-conditioned "what-if" simulations to predict potential future scenes and generate foresighted trajectory candidates. Building upon this, the VLM-oriented Evaluator (VLoE) leverages the reasoning capability of a large vision-language model to conduct multi-objective evaluations across safety, comfort, and efficiency dimensions, leading to reasoned and human-aligned decision making. Extensive experiments on the NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 benchmarks demonstrate that MindDrive achieves state-of-the-art performance across multi-dimensional driving metrics, significantly enhancing safety, compliance, and generalization. This work provides a promising path toward interpretable and cognitively guided autonomous driving.

AI.title_translation: MindDrive：一个连接世界模型和视觉语言模型的端到端自动驾驶一体化框架
AI.tldr: MindDrive是一个集成了轨迹生成和决策推理的自动驾驶框架，通过世界模型进行“假设”情景预测，并利用视觉语言模型进行多目标评估，在导航基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的端到端自动驾驶方法要么侧重于轨迹生成，要么侧重于轨迹选择，但都存在不足。本文提出MindDrive，旨在融合高质量轨迹生成和全面的决策推理能力，以实现更优的自动驾驶。
AI.method: MindDrive框架包含一个基于世界动作模型（WaM）的未来感知轨迹生成器（FaTG），用于进行“假设”情景模拟和预测，生成前瞻性轨迹候选。然后，一个面向VLM的评估器（VLoE）利用大型视觉语言模型的推理能力，跨安全、舒适和效率等多个维度进行评估。
AI.result: MindDrive在NAVSIM-v1和NAVSIM-v2基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，显著提高了安全、合规性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MindDrive提供了一种有前途的、可解释的、认知引导的自动驾驶方法，通过整合世界模型和视觉语言模型，实现了高质量的轨迹生成和全面的决策推理。
AI.translation: 端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）已成为一种新范式，其中轨迹规划起着至关重要的作用。现有研究主要遵循两个方向：面向轨迹生成的方向，侧重于通过简单的决策机制生成高质量轨迹；面向轨迹选择的方向，进行多维度评估以选择最佳轨迹，但缺乏足够的生成能力。在本研究中，我们提出了MindDrive，一个融合了高质量轨迹生成和全面决策推理能力的一体化框架。它建立了一个结构化的“上下文模拟-候选生成-多目标权衡”的推理范式。具体而言，我们提出的未来感知轨迹生成器（FaTG）基于世界动作模型（WaM），进行以自我为中心的“假设”情景模拟，以预测潜在的未来场景并生成具有前瞻性的轨迹候选。在此基础上，面向VLM的评估器（VLoE）利用大型视觉语言模型的推理能力，跨安全、舒适和效率维度进行多目标评估，从而实现有推理且符合人类认知的决策。在NAVSIM-v1和NAVSIM-v2基准测试上的广泛实验表明，MindDrive在多维度驾驶指标上实现了最先进的性能，显著提高了安全性、合规性和泛化能力。这项工作为实现可解释和认知引导的自动驾驶提供了一条有前景的途径。
AI.summary: MindDrive是一个创新的端到端自动驾驶框架，它将世界模型（WaM）与视觉语言模型（VLM）相结合。该框架首先利用WaM进行“假设”情景模拟，生成前瞻性的轨迹候选（FaTG），然后利用VLM的强大推理能力对这些候选轨迹进行安全、舒适和效率等多维度评估（VLoE），最终做出符合人类认知的决策。MindDrive在NAVSIM基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，为实现可解释和认知引导的自动驾驶提供了新的途径。
AI.keywords: 端到端自动驾驶, 世界模型, 视觉语言模型, 轨迹生成, 决策推理
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的MindDrive框架，将世界模型和视觉语言模型相结合，用于端到端自动驾驶。其核心创新在于“上下文模拟-候选生成-多目标权衡”的推理范式，通过FaTG进行前瞻性轨迹生成，并通过VLoE进行多维度评估，实现了更优的决策。该方法在提高安全性、合规性和泛化能力方面表现出色，并为可解释和认知引导的自动驾驶提供了新的研究方向。然而，对大规模真实世界场景的泛化能力和计算效率仍有待进一步验证。

title: AI-Assisted Game Management Decisions: A Fuzzy Logic Approach to Real-Time Soccer Substitutions
summary: In elite soccer, substitution decisions entail significant financial and sporting consequences yet remain heavily reliant on intuition or predictive models that merely mimic historical biases. This paper introduces a Fuzzy Logic based Decision Support System (DSS) designed for real time, prescriptive game management. Unlike traditional Machine Learning approaches that encounter a predictive ceiling by attempting to replicate human behavior, our system audits performance through an objective, rule based inference engine. We propose a methodological advancement by reformulating the PlayeRank metric into a Cumulative Mean with Role Aware Normalization, eliminating the play time exposure bias inherent in cumulative sum models to enable accurate intra match comparison. The system integrates this refined metric with physiological proxies (fatigue) and contextual variables (disciplinary risk modulated by tactical role) to calculate a dynamic Substitution Priority (P final). Validation via a case study of the 2018 FIFA World Cup match between Brazil and Belgium demonstrates the system's ecological validity: it not only aligned with expert consensus on executed substitutions (for example Gabriel Jesus) but, crucially, identified high risk scenarios ignored by human decision makers. Specifically, the model flagged the "FAGNER Paradox" - a maximum priority defensive risk - minutes before a critical yellow card, and detected the "Lukaku Paradox", where an isolated assist masked a severe drop in participation. These results confirm that Fuzzy Logic offers a transparent, explainable, and superior alternative to black box models for optimizing real time tactical decisions.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能辅助的足球比赛管理决策：一种用于实时足球换人的模糊逻辑方法
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于模糊逻辑的决策支持系统（DSS），用于实时、规范化的足球比赛管理。该系统通过改进的球员排名指标（考虑到角色和比赛时间暴露偏差）结合生理和情境变量，动态计算换人优先级。与模仿人类行为的传统机器学习模型不同，该系统使用基于规则的推理引擎进行客观性能审计。通过对2018年世界杯巴西对阵比利时比赛的案例研究验证，该系统不仅与专家对已执行换人的判断一致，还能识别出人类决策者忽略的高风险情况，例如“FAGNER悖论”和“Lukaku悖论”。研究结果表明，模糊逻辑为优化实时战术决策提供了一种透明、可解释且优于黑箱模型的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 当前的精英足球比赛中的换人决策，尽管具有重大的经济和体育影响，但很大程度上依赖于直觉或仅仅模仿历史偏见的预测模型。
AI.method: 本研究引入了一个基于模糊逻辑的决策支持系统（DSS），用于实时、规范化的比赛管理。该系统通过将PlayeRank指标重新表述为具有角色感知归一化的累积均值（Cumulative Mean with Role Aware Normalization），消除了累积和模型中固有的比赛时间暴露偏差，从而能够进行准确的比赛内比较。该系统将这一改进后的指标与生理代理（疲劳）和情境变量（由战术角色调节的纪律风险）相结合，以计算动态的换人优先级（P final）。
AI.result: 通过对2018年FIFA世界杯巴西对阵比利时比赛的案例研究验证，该系统显示出其生态有效性。它不仅与专家对已执行换人（例如加布里埃尔·热苏斯）的共识一致，而且关键在于，它识别出了人类决策者忽略的高风险情境。具体而言，该模型在关键黄牌出现前几分钟就标记出了“FAGNER悖论”——一种最高优先级的防守风险，并检测到“Lukaku悖论”——即一次孤立的助攻掩盖了参与度的严重下降。
AI.conclusion: 模糊逻辑为优化实时战术决策提供了一种透明、可解释且优于黑箱模型（如传统机器学习方法）的替代方案。
AI.translation: 在精英足球比赛中，换人决策涉及重大的经济和体育后果，但仍然在很大程度上依赖于直觉或仅仅模仿历史偏见的预测模型。本文介绍了一个基于模糊逻辑的决策支持系统（DSS），用于实时、规范化的比赛管理。与试图复制人类行为的传统机器学习方法不同，我们的系统通过一个客观的、基于规则的推理引擎来审计性能。我们提出了一种方法学上的进步，通过将PlayeRank指标重新表述为具有角色感知归一化的累积均值（Cumulative Mean with Role Aware Normalization），消除了累积和模型中固有的比赛时间暴露偏差，从而能够进行准确的比赛内比较。该系统将这一改进后的指标与生理代理（疲劳）和情境变量（由战术角色调节的纪律风险）相结合，以计算动态的换人优先级（P final）。通过对2018年FIFA世界杯巴西对阵比利时比赛的案例研究验证，该系统显示出其生态有效性：它不仅与专家对已执行换人（例如加布里埃尔·热苏斯）的共识一致，而且关键在于，它识别出了人类决策者忽略的高风险情境。具体而言，该模型在关键黄牌出现前几分钟就标记出了“FAGNER悖论”——一种最高优先级的防守风险，并检测到“Lukaku悖论”——即一次孤立的助攻掩盖了参与度的严重下降。这些结果证实，模糊逻辑为优化实时战术决策提供了一种透明、可解释且优于黑箱模型的替代方案。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的基于模糊逻辑的决策支持系统（DSS），用于解决精英足球比赛中实时换人决策的挑战。该系统通过引入一种新的球员表现评估指标——具有角色感知归一化的累积均值，克服了传统模型中存在的比赛时间偏差，并结合了生理疲劳和战术风险等因素，动态计算换人优先级。与依赖直觉或模仿历史偏见的模型不同，该DSS采用客观的、基于规则的推理，提供了透明且可解释的决策过程。通过对2018年世界杯比赛的案例分析，证明了该系统在识别专家未察觉的高风险情境方面优于人类决策者，为实时战术决策提供了更优的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 模糊逻辑, 足球换人, 决策支持系统, 球员表现评估, 实时战术决策
AI.comments: 该研究在足球比赛管理领域提出了一个创新的模糊逻辑方法，特别是在实时换人决策方面。其主要贡献在于开发了一种新的球员表现评估指标，克服了传统模型的局限性，并结合了多维度信息以实现动态优先级计算。模糊逻辑的应用带来了决策过程的透明度和可解释性，这对于需要高度信任和理解的体育决策尤为重要。然而，该研究的局限性可能在于其对生理数据和战术角色的量化方式，以及在不同联赛和比赛风格下的泛化能力。未来的研究可以进一步探索更复杂的变量集成和模型验证。

title: CryptoTensors: A Light-Weight Large Language Model File Format for Highly-Secure Model Distribution
summary:
To enhance the performance of large language models (LLMs) in various domain-specific applications, sensitive data such as healthcare, law, and finance are being used to privately customize or fine-tune these models. Such privately adapted LLMs are regarded as either personal privacy assets or corporate intellectual property. Therefore, protecting model weights and maintaining strict confidentiality during deployment and distribution have become critically important. However, existing model formats and deployment frameworks provide little to no built-in support for confidentiality, access control, or secure integration with trusted hardware. Current methods for securing model deployment either rely on computationally expensive cryptographic techniques or tightly controlled private infrastructure. Although these approaches can be effective in specific scenarios, they are difficult and costly for widespread deployment.
  In this paper, we introduce CryptoTensors, a secure and format-compatible file structure for confidential LLM distribution. Built as an extension to the widely adopted Safetensors format, CryptoTensors incorporates tensor-level encryption and embedded access control policies, while preserving critical features such as lazy loading and partial deserialization. It enables transparent decryption and automated key management, supporting flexible licensing and secure model execution with minimal overhead. We implement a proof-of-concept library, benchmark its performance across serialization and runtime scenarios, and validate its compatibility with existing inference frameworks, including Hugging Face Transformers and vLLM. Our results highlight CryptoTensors as a light-weight, efficient, and developer-friendly solution for safeguarding LLM weights in real-world and widespread deployments.

title: Infrared UAV Target Tracking with Dynamic Feature Refinement and Global Contextual Attention Knowledge Distillation
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) target tracking based on thermal infrared imaging has been one of the most important sensing technologies in anti-UAV applications. However, the infrared UAV targets often exhibit weak features and complex backgrounds, posing significant challenges to accurate tracking. To address these problems, we introduce SiamDFF, a novel dynamic feature fusion Siamese network that integrates feature enhancement and global contextual attention knowledge distillation for infrared UAV target (IRUT) tracking. The SiamDFF incorporates a selective target enhancement network (STEN), a dynamic spatial feature aggregation module (DSFAM), and a dynamic channel feature aggregation module (DCFAM). The STEN employs intensity-aware multi-head cross-attention to adaptively enhance important regions for both template and search branches. The DSFAM enhances multi-scale UAV target features by integrating local details with global features, utilizing spatial attention guidance within the search frame. The DCFAM effectively integrates the mixed template generated from STEN in the template branch and original template, avoiding excessive background interference with the template and thereby enhancing the emphasis on UAV target region features within the search frame. Furthermore, to enhance the feature extraction capabilities of the network for IRUT without adding extra computational burden, we propose a novel tracking-specific target-aware contextual attention knowledge distiller. It transfers the target prior from the teacher network to the student model, significantly improving the student network's focus on informative regions at each hierarchical level of the backbone network. Extensive experiments on real infrared UAV datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art target trackers under complex backgrounds while achieving a real-time tracking speed.

title: Exploiting ftrace's function_graph Tracer Features for Machine Learning: A Case Study on Encryption Detection
summary: This paper proposes using the Linux kernel ftrace framework, particularly the function graph tracer, to generate informative system level data for machine learning (ML) applications. Experiments on a real world encryption detection task demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed features across several learning algorithms. The learner faces the problem of detecting encryption activities across a large dataset of files, using function call traces and graph based features. Empirical results highlight an outstanding accuracy of 99.28 on the task at hand, underscoring the efficacy of features derived from the function graph tracer. The results were further validated in an additional experiment targeting a multilabel classification problem, in which running programs were identified from trace data. This work provides comprehensive methodologies for preprocessing raw trace data and extracting graph based features, offering significant advancements in applying ML to system behavior analysis, program identification, and anomaly detection. By bridging the gap between system tracing and ML, this paper paves the way for innovative solutions in performance monitoring and security analytics.

title: Topology Matters: Measuring Memory Leakage in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Graph topology is a fundamental determinant of memory leakage in multi-agent LLM systems, yet its effects remain poorly quantified. We introduce MAMA (Multi-Agent Memory Attack), a framework that measures how network structure shapes leakage. MAMA operates on synthetic documents containing labeled Personally Identifiable Information (PII) entities, from which we generate sanitized task instructions. We execute a two-phase protocol: Engram (seeding private information into a target agent's memory) and Resonance (multi-round interaction where an attacker attempts extraction). Over up to 10 interaction rounds, we quantify leakage as the fraction of ground-truth PII recovered from attacking agent outputs via exact matching. We systematically evaluate six common network topologies (fully connected, ring, chain, binary tree, star, and star-ring), varying agent counts $n\in\{4,5,6\}$, attacker-target placements, and base models. Our findings reveal consistent patterns: fully connected graphs exhibit maximum leakage while chains provide strongest protection; shorter attacker-target graph distance and higher target centrality significantly increase vulnerability; leakage rises sharply in early rounds before plateauing; model choice shifts absolute leakage rates but preserves topology rankings; temporal/locational PII attributes leak more readily than identity credentials or regulated identifiers. These results provide the first systematic mapping from architectural choices to measurable privacy risk, yielding actionable guidance: prefer sparse or hierarchical connectivity, maximize attacker-target separation, limit node degree and network radius, avoid shortcuts bypassing hubs, and implement topology-aware access controls.

title: Towards Cross-View Point Correspondence in Vision-Language Models
summary: Cross-view correspondence is a fundamental capability for spatial understanding and embodied AI. However, it is still far from being realized in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), especially in achieving precise point-level correspondence, which is crucial for precise affordance interaction. So we propose the Cross-View Point Correspondence (CVPC) task and CrossPoint-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark with hierarchical design, inspired by the human cognitive process of "perceive", "reason", and "correspond". Our evaluation shows the state-of-the-art models (e.g., Gemini-2.5-Pro) still fall far behind humans, with a gap of over 54.65% in overall accuracy, exposing a challenge in transitioning from coarse-grained judgement to fine-grained coordinate prediction. To address this problem, we construct CrossPoint-378K, a dataset with 378K question-answering pairs across 900 scenes, focused on actionable affordance regions that better reflect real-world manipulation and interaction scenarios. Furthermore, we propose CroPond that trained on the CrossPoint-378K dataset. Our CroPond achieves state-of-the-art performance on CrossPoint-Bench, surpassing Gemini-2.5-Pro by 39.7% accuracy, which offers a foundation for advancing future work on cross-view correspondence. The benchmark, dataset, and model are publicly available at https://github.com/WangYipu2002/CrossPoint.

title: POLARIS: Is Multi-Agentic Reasoning the Next Wave in Engineering Self-Adaptive Systems?
comments: Accepted as a short paper at SEAMS 2026
summary: The growing scale, complexity, interconnectivity, and autonomy of modern software ecosystems introduce unprecedented uncertainty, challenging the foundations of traditional self-adaptation. Existing approaches, typically rule-driven controllers or isolated learning components, struggle to generalize to novel contexts or coordinate responses across distributed subsystems, leaving them ill-equipped for emergent unknown unknowns. Recent discussions on Self-Adaptation 2.0 emphasize an equal partnership between AI and adaptive systems, merging learning-driven intelligence with adaptive control for predictive and proactive behavior. Building on this foundation, we introduce POLARIS, a three-layer multi-agentic self-adaptation framework that advances beyond reactive adaptation. POLARIS integrates: (1) a low-latency Adapter layer for monitoring and safe execution, (2) a transparent Reasoning layer that generates and verifies plans using tool-aware, explainable agents, and (3) a Meta layer that records experiences and meta-learns improved adaptation policies over time. Through shared knowledge and predictive models, POLARIS handles uncertainty, learns from past actions, and evolves its strategies, enabling systems that anticipate change and maintain resilient, goal-directed behavior. Preliminary evaluation on two self-adaptive exemplars, SWIM and SWITCH, shows that POLARIS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. We argue this marks a shift toward Self-Adaptation 3.0, akin to Software 3.0: a paradigm where systems not only learn from their environment but also reason about and evolve their own adaptation processes, continuously improving to meet novel challenges.
comment: Accepted as a short paper at SEAMS 2026

title: DaLA: Danish Linguistic Acceptability Evaluation Guided by Real World Errors
summary: We present an enhanced benchmark for evaluating linguistic acceptability in Danish. We first analyze the most common errors found in written Danish. Based on this analysis, we introduce a set of fourteen corruption functions that generate incorrect sentences by systematically introducing errors into existing correct Danish sentences. To ensure the accuracy of these corruptions, we assess their validity using both manual and automatic methods. The results are then used as a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models on a linguistic acceptability judgement task. Our findings demonstrate that this extension is both broader and more comprehensive than the current state of the art. By incorporating a greater variety of corruption types, our benchmark provides a more rigorous assessment of linguistic acceptability, increasing task difficulty, as evidenced by the lower performance of LLMs on our benchmark compared to existing ones. Our results also suggest that our benchmark has a higher discriminatory power which allows to better distinguish well-performing models from low-performing ones.

title: EMMA: Efficient Multimodal Understanding, Generation, and Editing with a Unified Architecture
summary: We propose EMMA, an efficient and unified architecture for multimodal understanding, generation and editing. Specifically, EMMA primarily consists of 1) An efficient autoencoder with a 32x compression ratio, which significantly reduces the number of tokens required for generation. This also ensures the training balance between understanding and generation tasks by applying the same compression ratio to images. 2) Channel-wise concatenation instead of token-wise concatenation among visual understanding and generation tokens, which further reduces the visual tokens in unified architectures. 3) A shared-and-decoupled network that enables mutual improvements across tasks while meeting the task-specific modeling requirements. 4) A mixture-of-experts mechanism adopted for visual understanding encoder, which substantially improves perceptual capabilities with a few parameters increase. Extensive experiments have shown that EMMA-4B can significantly outperform state-of-the-art unified multimodal approaches (e.g., BAGEL-7B) in both efficiency and performance, while also achieving competitive results compared to recent multimodal understanding and generation experts (e.g., Qwen3-VL and Qwen-Image). We believe that EMMA lays a solid foundation for the future development of unified multimodal architectures.

title: Model-Based and Sample-Efficient AI-Assisted Math Discovery in Sphere Packing
summary: Sphere packing, Hilbert's eighteenth problem, asks for the densest arrangement of congruent spheres in n-dimensional Euclidean space. Although relevant to areas such as cryptography, crystallography, and medical imaging, the problem remains unresolved: beyond a few special dimensions, neither optimal packings nor tight upper bounds are known. Even a major breakthrough in dimension $n=8$, later recognised with a Fields Medal, underscores its difficulty. A leading technique for upper bounds, the three-point method, reduces the problem to solving large, high-precision semidefinite programs (SDPs). Because each candidate SDP may take days to evaluate, standard data-intensive AI approaches are infeasible. We address this challenge by formulating SDP construction as a sequential decision process, the SDP game, in which a policy assembles SDP formulations from a set of admissible components. Using a sample-efficient model-based framework that combines Bayesian optimisation with Monte Carlo Tree Search, we obtain new state-of-the-art upper bounds in dimensions $4-16$, showing that model-based search can advance computational progress in longstanding geometric problems. Together, these results demonstrate that sample-efficient, model-based search can make tangible progress on mathematically rigid, evaluation limited problems, pointing towards a complementary direction for AI-assisted discovery beyond large-scale LLM-driven exploration.

title: Stability-Guaranteed Dual Kalman Filtering for Electrochemical Battery State Estimation
comments: This work has been submitted to 23rd IFAC World Congress for possible publication
summary: Accurate and stable state estimation is critical for battery management. Although dual Kalman filtering can jointly estimate states and parameters, the strong coupling between filters may cause divergence under large initialization errors or model mismatch. This paper proposes a Stability Guaranteed Dual Kalman Filtering (SG-DKF) method. A Lyapunov-based analysis yields a sufficient stability condition, leading to an adaptive dead-zone rule that suspends parameter updates when the innovation exceeds a stability bound. Applied to an electrochemical battery model, SG-DKF achieves accuracy comparable to a dual EKF and reduces state of charge RMSE by over 45% under large initial state errors.
comment: This work has been submitted to 23rd IFAC World Congress for possible publication

title: The AI Consumer Index (ACE)
summary: We introduce the first version of the AI Consumer Index (ACE), a benchmark for assessing whether frontier AI models can perform everyday consumer tasks. ACE contains a hidden heldout set of 400 test cases, split across four consumer activities: shopping, food, gaming, and DIY. We are also open sourcing 80 cases as a devset with a CC-BY license. For the ACE leaderboard we evaluated 10 frontier models (with websearch turned on) using a novel grading methodology that dynamically checks whether relevant parts of the response are grounded in the retrieved web sources. GPT 5 (Thinking = High) is the top-performing model, scoring 56.1%, followed by o3 Pro (Thinking = On) at 55.2% and GPT 5.1 (Thinking = High) at 55.1%. Model scores differ across domains, and in Shopping the top model scores under 50\%. We find that models are prone to hallucinating key information, such as prices. ACE shows a substantial gap between the performance of even the best models and consumers' AI needs.

title: FASTer: Toward Efficient Autoregressive Vision Language Action Modeling via Neural Action Tokenization
summary: Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models have recently demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation. However, their core process of action tokenization often involves a trade-off between reconstruction fidelity and inference efficiency. We introduce FASTer, a unified framework for efficient and generalizable robot learning that integrates a learnable tokenizer with an autoregressive policy built upon it. FASTerVQ encodes action chunks as single-channel images, capturing global spatio-temporal dependencies while maintaining a high compression ratio. FASTerVLA builds on this tokenizer with block-wise autoregressive decoding and a lightweight action expert, achieving both faster inference and higher task performance. Extensive experiments across simulated and real-world benchmarks show that FASTerVQ delivers superior reconstruction quality, high token utilization, and strong cross-task and cross-embodiment generalization, while FASTerVLA further improves overall capability, surpassing previous state-of-the-art VLA models in both inference speed and task performance.

title: Configuration Defects in Kubernetes
summary: Kubernetes is a tool that facilitates rapid deployment of software. Unfortunately, configuring Kubernetes is prone to errors. Configuration defects are not uncommon and can result in serious consequences. This paper reports an empirical study about configuration defects in Kubernetes with the goal of helping practitioners detect and prevent these defects. We study 719 defects that we extract from 2,260 Kubernetes configuration scripts using open source repositories. Using qualitative analysis, we identify 15 categories of defects. We find 8 publicly available static analysis tools to be capable of detecting 8 of the 15 defect categories. We find that the highest precision and recall of those tools are for defects related to data fields. We develop a linter to detect two categories of defects that cause serious consequences, which none of the studied tools are able to detect. Our linter revealed 26 previously-unknown defects that have been confirmed by practitioners, 19 of which have already been fixed. We conclude our paper by providing recommendations on how defect detection and repair techniques can be used for Kubernetes configuration scripts. The datasets and source code used for the paper are publicly available online.

title: Personalizing Agent Privacy Decisions via Logical Entailment
summary: Personal language model-based agents are becoming more widespread for completing tasks on behalf of users; however, this raises serious privacy questions regarding whether these models will appropriately disclose user data. While prior work has evaluated language models on data-sharing scenarios based on general privacy norms, we focus on personalizing language models' privacy decisions, grounding their judgments directly in prior user privacy decisions. Our findings suggest that general privacy norms are insufficient for effective personalization of privacy decisions. Furthermore, we find that eliciting privacy judgments from the model through In-context Learning (ICL) is unreliable to due misalignment with the user's prior privacy judgments and opaque reasoning traces, which make it difficult for the user to interpret the reasoning behind the model's decisions. To address these limitations, we propose ARIEL (Agentic Reasoning with Individualized Entailment Logic), a framework that jointly leverages a language model and rule-based logic for structured data-sharing reasoning. ARIEL is based on formulating personalization of data sharing as an entailment, whether a prior user judgment on a data-sharing request implies the same judgment for an incoming request. Our experimental evaluations on advanced models and publicly-available datasets demonstrate that ARIEL can reduce the F1 score error by $\textbf{39.1%}$ over language model-based reasoning (ICL), demonstrating that ARIEL is effective at correctly judging requests where the user would approve data sharing. Overall, our findings suggest that combining LLMs with strict logical entailment is a highly effective strategy for enabling personalized privacy judgments for agents.

title: TV2TV: A Unified Framework for Interleaved Language and Video Generation
summary: Video generation models are rapidly advancing, but can still struggle with complex video outputs that require significant semantic branching or repeated high-level reasoning about what should happen next. In this paper, we introduce a new class of omni video-text models that integrate ideas from recent LM reasoning advances to address this challenge. More specifically, we present TV2TV, a unified generative modeling framework which decomposes video generation into an interleaved text and video generation process. TV2TV jointly learns language modeling (next-token prediction) and video flow matching (next-frame prediction) using a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. At inference time, TV2TV decides when to alternate between generating text and video frames, allowing the model to "think in words" about subsequent content before ``acting in pixels'' to produce frames. This design offloads much of the responsibility for deciding what should happen next to the language modeling tower, enabling improved visual quality and prompt alignment of generated videos. It also enables fine-grained controllability, allowing users to modify the video generation trajectory through text interventions at any point in the process. In controlled experiments on video game data, TV2TV demonstrates substantial improvements in both visual quality and controllability. TV2TV also scales to natural videos, as we show by augmenting sports videos with interleaved natural language action descriptions using vision-language models (VLMs). Training TV2TV on this corpus yields strong visual quality and prompt alignment, showcasing the model's ability to reason about and generate complex real-world action sequences. Together, these results highlight TV2TV as a promising step toward video generation with open-ended textual reasoning and control.

title: NeuralRemaster: Phase-Preserving Diffusion for Structure-Aligned Generation
summary: Standard diffusion corrupts data using Gaussian noise whose Fourier coefficients have random magnitudes and random phases. While effective for unconditional or text-to-image generation, corrupting phase components destroys spatial structure, making it ill-suited for tasks requiring geometric consistency, such as re-rendering, simulation enhancement, and image-to-image translation. We introduce Phase-Preserving Diffusion φ-PD, a model-agnostic reformulation of the diffusion process that preserves input phase while randomizing magnitude, enabling structure-aligned generation without architectural changes or additional parameters. We further propose Frequency-Selective Structured (FSS) noise, which provides continuous control over structural rigidity via a single frequency-cutoff parameter. φ-PD adds no inference-time cost and is compatible with any diffusion model for images or videos. Across photorealistic and stylized re-rendering, as well as sim-to-real enhancement for driving planners, φ-PD produces controllable, spatially aligned results. When applied to the CARLA simulator, φ-PD improves CARLA-to-Waymo planner performance by 50\%. The method is complementary to existing conditioning approaches and broadly applicable to image-to-image and video-to-video generation. Videos, additional examples, and code are available on our \href{https://yuzeng-at-tri.github.io/ppd-page/}{project page}.

title: Splannequin: Freezing Monocular Mannequin-Challenge Footage with Dual-Detection Splatting
summary: Synthesizing high-fidelity frozen 3D scenes from monocular Mannequin-Challenge (MC) videos is a unique problem distinct from standard dynamic scene reconstruction. Instead of focusing on modeling motion, our goal is to create a frozen scene while strategically preserving subtle dynamics to enable user-controlled instant selection. To achieve this, we introduce a novel application of dynamic Gaussian splatting: the scene is modeled dynamically, which retains nearby temporal variation, and a static scene is rendered by fixing the model's time parameter. However, under this usage, monocular capture with sparse temporal supervision introduces artifacts like ghosting and blur for Gaussians that become unobserved or occluded at weakly supervised timestamps. We propose Splannequin, an architecture-agnostic regularization that detects two states of Gaussian primitives, hidden and defective, and applies temporal anchoring. Under predominantly forward camera motion, hidden states are anchored to their recent well-observed past states, while defective states are anchored to future states with stronger supervision. Our method integrates into existing dynamic Gaussian pipelines via simple loss terms, requires no architectural changes, and adds zero inference overhead. This results in markedly improved visual quality, enabling high-fidelity, user-selectable frozen-time renderings, validated by a 96% user preference. Project page: https://chien90190.github.io/splannequin/

title: The Universal Weight Subspace Hypothesis
summary: We show that deep neural networks trained across diverse tasks exhibit remarkably similar low-dimensional parametric subspaces. We provide the first large-scale empirical evidence that demonstrates that neural networks systematically converge to shared spectral subspaces regardless of initialization, task, or domain. Through mode-wise spectral analysis of over 1100 models - including 500 Mistral-7B LoRAs, 500 Vision Transformers, and 50 LLaMA-8B models - we identify universal subspaces capturing majority variance in just a few principal directions. By applying spectral decomposition techniques to the weight matrices of various architectures trained on a wide range of tasks and datasets, we identify sparse, joint subspaces that are consistently exploited, within shared architectures across diverse tasks and datasets. Our findings offer new insights into the intrinsic organization of information within deep networks and raise important questions about the possibility of discovering these universal subspaces without the need for extensive data and computational resources. Furthermore, this inherent structure has significant implications for model reusability, multi-task learning, model merging, and the development of training and inference-efficient algorithms, potentially reducing the carbon footprint of large-scale neural models.

title: Semantic Faithfulness and Entropy Production Measures to Tame Your LLM Demons and Manage Hallucinations
summary: Evaluating faithfulness of Large Language Models (LLMs) to a given task is a complex challenge. We propose two new unsupervised metrics for faithfulness evaluation using insights from information theory and thermodynamics. Our approach treats an LLM as a bipartite information engine where hidden layers act as a Maxwell demon controlling transformations of context $C $ into answer $A$ via prompt $Q$. We model Question-Context-Answer (QCA) triplets as probability distributions over shared topics. Topic transformations from $C$ to $Q$ and $A$ are modeled as transition matrices ${\bf Q}$ and ${\bf A}$ encoding the query goal and actual result, respectively. Our semantic faithfulness (SF) metric quantifies faithfulness for any given QCA triplet by the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between these matrices. Both matrices are inferred simultaneously via convex optimization of this KL divergence, and the final SF metric is obtained by mapping the minimal divergence onto the unit interval [0,1], where higher scores indicate greater faithfulness. Furthermore, we propose a thermodynamics-based semantic entropy production (SEP) metric in answer generation, and show that high faithfulness generally implies low entropy production. The SF and SEP metrics can be used jointly or separately for LLM evaluation and hallucination control. We demonstrate our framework on LLM summarization of corporate SEC 10-K filings.

title: MuMeNet: A Network Simulator for Musical Metaverse Communications
comments: To appear in 2025 IEEE 6th International Symposium on the Internet of Sounds (IS2) proceedings
summary: The Metaverse, a shared and spatially organized digital continuum, is transforming various industries, with music emerging as a leading use case. Live concerts, collaborative composition, and interactive experiences are driving the Musical Metaverse (MM), but the requirements of the underlying network and service infrastructures hinder its growth. These challenges underscore the need for a novel modeling and simulation paradigm tailored to the unique characteristics of MM sessions, along with specialized service provisioning strategies capable of capturing their interactive, heterogeneous, and multicast-oriented nature. To this end, we make a first attempt to formally model and analyze the problem of service provisioning for MM sessions in 5G/6G networks. We first formalize service and network graph models for the MM, using "live audience interaction in a virtual concert" as a reference scenario. We then present MuMeNet, a novel discrete-event network simulator specifically tailored to the requirements and the traffic dynamics of the MM. We showcase the effectiveness of MuMeNet by running a linear programming based orchestration policy on the reference scenario and providing performance analysis under realistic MM workloads.
comment: To appear in 2025 IEEE 6th International Symposium on the Internet of Sounds (IS2) proceedings

title: Disturbance Compensation for Safe Kinematic Control of Robotic Systems with Closed Architecture
comments: Extended version of the paper submitted for publication. This document contains detailed mathematical derivations and additional experimental results omitted from the submission due to page constraints
summary: In commercial robotic systems, it is common to encounter a closed inner-loop torque controller that is not user-modifiable. However, the outer-loop controller, which sends kinematic commands such as position or velocity for the inner-loop controller to track, is typically exposed to users. In this work, we focus on the development of an easily integrated add-on at the outer-loop layer by combining disturbance rejection control and robust control barrier function for high-performance tracking and safe control of the whole dynamic system of an industrial manipulator. This is particularly beneficial when 1) the inner-loop controller is imperfect, unmodifiable, and uncertain; and 2) the dynamic model exhibits significant uncertainty. Stability analysis, formal safety guarantee proof, and hardware experiments with a PUMA robotic manipulator are presented. Our solution demonstrates superior performance in terms of simplicity of implementation, robustness, tracking precision, and safety compared to the state of the art. Video: https://youtu.be/zw1tanvrV8Q

title: Simulating Life Paths with Digital Twins: AI-Generated Future Selves Influence Decision-Making and Expand Human Choice
summary: Major life transitions demand high-stakes decisions, yet people often struggle to imagine how their future selves will live with the consequences. To support this limited capacity for mental time travel, we introduce AI-enabled digital twins that have ``lived through'' simulated life scenarios. Rather than predicting optimal outcomes, these simulations extend prospective cognition by making alternative futures vivid enough to support deliberation without assuming which path is best. We evaluate this idea in a randomized controlled study (N=192) using multimodal synthesis - facial age progression, voice cloning, and large language model dialogue - to create personalized avatars representing participants 30 years forward. Young adults 18 to 28 years old described pending binary decisions and were assigned to guided imagination or one of four avatar conditions: single-option, balanced dual-option, or expanded three-option with a system-generated novel alternative. Results showed asymmetric effects: single-sided avatars increased shifts toward the presented option, while balanced presentation produced movement toward both. Introducing a system-generated third option increased adoption of this new alternative compared to control, suggesting that AI-generated future selves can expand choice by surfacing paths that might otherwise go unnoticed. Participants rated evaluative reasoning and eudaimonic meaning-making as more important than emotional or visual vividness. Perceived persuasiveness and baseline agency predicted decision change. These findings advance understanding of AI-mediated episodic prospection and raise questions about autonomy in AI-augmented decisions.

title: LMSpell: Neural Spell Checking for Low-Resource Languages
summary: Spell correction is still a challenging problem for low-resource languages (LRLs). While pretrained language models (PLMs) have been employed for spell correction, their use is still limited to a handful of languages, and there has been no proper comparison across PLMs. We present the first empirical study on the effectiveness of PLMs for spell correction, which includes LRLs. We find that Large Language Models (LLMs) outperform their counterparts (encoder-based and encoder-decoder) when the fine-tuning dataset is large. This observation holds even in languages for which the LLM is not pre-trained. We release LMSpell, an easy- to use spell correction toolkit across PLMs. It includes an evaluation function that compensates for the hallucination of LLMs. Further, we present a case study with Sinhala to shed light on the plight of spell correction for LRLs.

title: TeleAI-Safety: A comprehensive LLM jailbreaking benchmark towards attacks, defenses, and evaluations
summary: While the deployment of large language models (LLMs) in high-value industries continues to expand, the systematic assessment of their safety against jailbreak and prompt-based attacks remains insufficient. Existing safety evaluation benchmarks and frameworks are often limited by an imbalanced integration of core components (attack, defense, and evaluation methods) and an isolation between flexible evaluation frameworks and standardized benchmarking capabilities. These limitations hinder reliable cross-study comparisons and create unnecessary overhead for comprehensive risk assessment. To address these gaps, we present TeleAI-Safety, a modular and reproducible framework coupled with a systematic benchmark for rigorous LLM safety evaluation. Our framework integrates a broad collection of 19 attack methods (including one self-developed method), 29 defense methods, and 19 evaluation methods (including one self-developed method). With a curated attack corpus of 342 samples spanning 12 distinct risk categories, the TeleAI-Safety benchmark conducts extensive evaluations across 14 target models. The results reveal systematic vulnerabilities and model-specific failure cases, highlighting critical trade-offs between safety and utility, and identifying potential defense patterns for future optimization. In practical scenarios, TeleAI-Safety can be flexibly adjusted with customized attack, defense, and evaluation combinations to meet specific demands. We release our complete code and evaluation results to facilitate reproducible research and establish unified safety baselines.

title: Know-Show: Benchmarking Video-Language Models on Spatio-Temporal Grounded Reasoning
summary: Large Video-Language Models (Video-LMs) have achieved impressive progress in multimodal understanding, yet their reasoning remains weakly grounded in space and time. We present Know-Show, a new benchmark designed to evaluate spatio-temporal grounded reasoning, the ability of a model to reason about actions and their semantics while simultaneously grounding its inferences in visual and temporal evidence.
